criteria.criterion: Respect task constraints (sole source, exact copying, no extra fields, stop at requested fields)
criteria.description: Information must be taken only from the displayed Unihan record for U+4E00; readings/encodings must be copied exactly as shown (no transliteration/translation/normalization; preserve diacritics, capitalization, punctuation, spacing); do not substitute a related ideograph; and stop after reporting the requested identity/encodings/stroke count/definition and the four language readings. Full credit if all constraints are followed. Partial credit if minor extra non-conflicting content is included or minor formatting differences occur while the core data remains clearly from the record. No credit if the agent fabricates/infer values, uses other sources, or reports a different character’s data.

screenshot_context.verifier_evidence: Screenshot 1 supports only the encodings table and kTotalStrokes. Screenshots do not show kDefinition or the reading fields, so the agent’s exact copying for those cannot be visually verified. The agent output also shows formatting/normalization differences vs what Unihan typically displays (e.g., tone-marked Mandarin, missing punctuation).
screenshot_context.verifier_justification: Constraints require exact copying from labeled fields. The agent’s output includes at least one clear normalization/formatting deviation (Mandarin rendered with diacritic instead of the record’s format; Japanese On reading punctuation likely altered). Even though not all fields are visible in screenshots, the output itself indicates non-verbatim copying, so partial credit is appropriate.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: The screenshot visibly contains only: the page title “Unihan data for U+4E00”, a blank-looking glyph box (glyph not clearly legible), an “Encoding Forms” table with Decimal/UTF-8/UTF-16/UTF-32 values, and an “IRG Sources” table showing kTotalStrokes = 1 among other source fields. No fields for kDefinition, kMandarin, kJapaneseOn, kKorean, or kVietnamese are visible anywhere in this screenshot frame.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: Not fully satisfied based on the screenshot. The agent’s predicted output includes definition and multiple language readings that are not shown on-screen here, so those parts cannot be verified as copied “only from the supplied record” as displayed. Encodings and kTotalStrokes do appear and can be consistent, but the definition/readings appear to be sourced from outside what is visible in this screenshot (or from a scroll position not evidenced here).
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: Agent’s predicted output states: glyph “一”, kDefinition “one; a, an; alone”, kMandarin “yī”, kJapaneseOn “ICHI ITSU”, kKorean “IL”, kVietnamese “nhất”. None of these labeled fields (definition/readings) are visible in the provided screenshot, so the claim that these were taken from the displayed record is not supported by this image. The agent also provides the glyph character, but the glyph is not clearly readable in the screenshot’s glyph box.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: Only Unihan field tables are visible (various index fields and Dictionary-like Data). The screenshot does not show any of the requested output fields such as “Encoding Forms”, kTotalStrokes, kDefinition, or reading fields like kMandarin/kJapaneseOn/kKorean/kVietnamese. The visible values include examples like kCihaiT: “1.101”, kCowles: “5133”, kGSR: “0394a”, kKarlgren: “175”, kSBGY: “468.40”, and Dictionary-like values like kCangjie: “M”, kFenn: “1A”, kFourCornerCode: “1000.0”, kGradeLevel: “1”, kHKGLyph: “0001”, kUnihanCore2020: “GHJKMPT”.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: Because the screenshot does not display the fields the agent reported (glyph, decimal, UTF-8/UTF-16, kTotalStrokes, kDefinition, and language readings), there is no visual support that the agent copied them exactly from this screenshot. The predicted output could still be correct, but it is unsupported by the provided screenshot, and thus constraint compliance (sole source, exact copying) cannot be verified here.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: Predicted output includes kDefinition and language readings and encodings, none of which are visible in the screenshot. No contradiction is visible, but the evidence is missing.

dom_model_context.verifier_evidence: DOM-model states 0/1 explicitly show the Glyph and Encoding Forms table and kTotalStrokes, but do not show any rows for kDefinition, kMandarin, kJapaneseOn, kKorean, or kVietnamese (latest: state 1).
